tasks.title: Unify modifier-complete Android key routing
tasks.description: Create one app-level dispatcher in ConnectingScreen.kt, or a small helper nearby, used by both TerminalViewClient.onKeyDown() and TerminalImeBridgeEditText's OnKeyListener. The dispatcher should snapshot pendingModifiers, combine them with event meta-state Ctrl/Alt/Shift, call TerminalInputRouter with explicit external modifier flags or a small modifier value object, and clear app-latched modifiers only after a data-producing key is handled successfully. It must leave latches intact for Back, ignored system keys, and unsuccessful routing. Apply one consistent policy for known and unknown ACTION_MULTIPLE events.

risks: Selection dismissal is in vendored Termux code; incorrect callback ordering could cause duplicate copyModeChanged notifications, stale ActionMode references, or leaked handles.
Focus restoration can accidentally show the soft keyboard after the user intentionally hid it unless keyboardVisibleRequested is treated as intent and not overwritten.
Clearing pendingModifiers too early can break compact one-shot modifiers for ignored system keys, Back, or failed router paths.
Changing ACTION_MULTIPLE handling may regress repeated hardware keys or unknown-character input from IMEs.
TerminalInputRouter uses Android KeyEvent unicode behavior, which can vary by device/keymap; tests should prefer exact byte sinks and explicit meta states.
Managed emulator tasks may be unavailable or slow in the current environment; report exact skipped validations rather than substituting broad claims.
The hidden-editor sentinel may interact with context menu copy/cut/select-all behavior; defer cleanup if it expands patch scope.
